items.title: The Bus Stop Survey
items.topic: students using a short survey to understand why some classmates arrived late on rainy mornings
items.benefit: the survey revealed that several bus routes became crowded and delayed at the same time
items.challenge: students who answered the survey were not a perfect sample of everyone who used the buses
items.lesson: survey results are useful when readers also consider who answered and who may be missing
items.topicJa: 雨の日の遅刻理由を短い調査で調べる活動
items.benefitJa: 複数のバス路線が同じ時間帯に混雑して遅れることが分かったこと
items.challengeJa: 回答者がバス利用者全体を完全には代表していないこと
items.lessonJa: 調査結果は回答した人と含まれていない人の両方を考えて読む必要がある

items.title: Saving Heat in the Classroom
items.topic: a class comparing simple ways to keep a classroom warm without wasting energy
items.benefit: closing unused doors and adjusting curtains reduced heat loss during cold mornings
items.challenge: keeping every curtain closed also reduced useful daylight and made the room feel darker
items.lesson: an efficient solution often requires balancing more than one goal instead of maximizing only one
items.topicJa: 無駄なエネルギーを使わず教室を暖かく保つ方法の比較
items.benefitJa: 使わない扉を閉めカーテンを調整すると寒い朝の熱損失を減らせたこと
items.challengeJa: すべてのカーテンを閉めると自然光も減って教室が暗くなること
items.lessonJa: 効率的な解決には一つの目標だけでなく複数の目的のバランスが必要

items.title: A Week Without Paper Notices
items.topic: a school testing digital notices for one week to reduce paper use
items.benefit: teachers could correct information quickly and students carried fewer printed sheets
items.challenge: some families did not check the digital system regularly and missed time-sensitive information
items.lesson: a new communication method should be judged by whether information reaches people, not only by how easily it is sent
items.topicJa: 紙を減らすため一週間デジタル連絡を試す学校の取り組み
items.benefitJa: 情報をすぐ修正でき生徒が持ち帰る紙も減ったこと
items.challengeJa: デジタル連絡を頻繁に確認しない家庭が重要な情報を見落としたこと
items.lessonJa: 連絡手段は送りやすさだけでなく相手に届くかで評価する必要がある

items.title: The Shorter Lunch Line
items.topic: students testing two serving arrangements to reduce waiting time at lunch
items.benefit: placing the most common choices first made the average line move faster
items.challenge: students with dietary restrictions sometimes needed extra time and felt pressured by the faster line
items.lesson: improving average speed should not make a service harder for people with different needs
items.topicJa: 昼食の待ち時間を減らすため配膳方法を比較する活動
items.benefitJa: よく選ばれる物を先に置くと平均的な列の進みが速くなったこと
items.challengeJa: 食事制限のある生徒は時間が必要で速い列に急かされることがあったこと
items.lessonJa: 平均速度の改善が異なる事情を持つ人の利用を難しくしないよう考える必要がある
